fusions.name: Footsore Nip
fusions.desc: A nip that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +40%).

fusions.name: Column on the Move
fusions.desc: Your marching column of rats tramples through a cone 6 tiles long, and deals 28 damage to everything in it plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Keep the Pack Moving
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds, and your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Miles Mend Bites
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
